description: This file defines a class 'CodeGeneratorDraft04' for generating validation code based on JSON Schema draft-04 specifications. It includes methods for validating types, enums, allOf, anyOf, oneOf, not, string patterns, formats, numeric bounds, array and object properties, dependencies, and more, using regex and code generation techniques.

classes.name: CodeGeneratorDraft04
classes.description: A class for generating validation code from JSON Schema draft-04 definitions, with methods for various validation rules.

methods.name: generate_type
methods.description: Validates the 'type' field in JSON Schema, supporting multiple types and special handling for booleans.

methods.name: generate_enum
methods.description: Validates that a value is within a specified enum list.

methods.name: generate_all_of
methods.description: Validates that a value matches all schemas in 'allOf'.

methods.name: generate_any_of
methods.description: Validates that a value matches at least one schema in 'anyOf'.

methods.name: generate_one_of
methods.description: Validates that a value matches exactly one schema in 'oneOf'.

methods.name: generate_not
methods.description: Validates that a value does not match the 'not' schema.

methods.name: generate_min_length
methods.description: Validates minimum string length.

methods.name: generate_max_length
methods.description: Validates maximum string length.

methods.name: generate_pattern
methods.description: Validates string against a regex pattern.

methods.name: generate_format
methods.description: Validates string format (e.g., email, hostname, ipv4, ipv6, uri).

methods.name: _generate_format
methods.description: Helper to compile regex for formats and validate.

methods.name: generate_minimum
methods.description: Validates numeric minimum, considering exclusiveMinimum.

methods.name: generate_maximum
methods.description: Validates numeric maximum, considering exclusiveMaximum.

methods.name: generate_multiple_of
methods.description: Validates that a number is a multiple of a given value.

methods.name: generate_min_items
methods.description: Validates minimum array length.

methods.name: generate_max_items
methods.description: Validates maximum array length.

methods.name: generate_unique_items
methods.description: Validates array items are unique.

methods.name: generate_items
methods.description: Validates array items against specified schemas or types.

methods.name: generate_min_properties
methods.description: Validates minimum number of object properties.

methods.name: generate_max_properties
methods.description: Validates maximum number of object properties.

methods.name: generate_required
methods.description: Validates required object properties.

methods.name: generate_properties
methods.description: Validates object properties against defined schemas.

methods.name: generate_pattern_properties
methods.description: Validates object keys matching regex patterns.

methods.name: generate_additional_properties
methods.description: Validates additional object properties based on schema.

methods.name: generate_dependencies
methods.description: Validates property dependencies within objects.
